- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8594 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]

  PROBLEM: The review-blocked OpenCode fix writer runs directly on the host rather than through `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh`, and Serena mode remains conditionally enabled.
  WHY: The fix writer reads untrusted PR content while having access to credentials and the checkout's `.git`; Serena MCP tools also remain available.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21374; lines 21526-21535 (and 21595) | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked combined-fix push stores `GH_TOKEN` in Git configuration via `remote set-url` instead of using a one-shot credential helper.
  WHY: The token remains readable from Git configuration after the push; severity disagreement: some reviewers rate this major, while others rate it blocker, so the highest severity is shown.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339, 621 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root guard's assignment regexes do not recognize Bash append assignments (`NAME+=value`) like the template does.
  WHY: Append-assignment-prefixed Git commands can bypass the merged-PR guard, and the root/template divergence causes parser and byte-parity tests to fail.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root guard's assignment-stripping loop does not correctly track `NAME+=value` environment assignments such as `GIT_DIR+=...`.
  WHY: Splitting the token on `=` leaves the name as `GIT_DIR+`, so environment tracking can misclassify a `GIT_DIR+=... git push` as safe.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: line 54 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: `ORCH_SCRIPTS_ROOT` is based on `$(pwd)` instead of the script's actual location.
  WHY: Running the script outside the repository root can make `ORCH_CODEX_ISOLATED_EXEC` resolve to a nonexistent path and break judge execution.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: Lines 14630, 21014, 22927 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The stall judge, review-blocked judge, and wave judge still run Codex directly on the host.
  WHY: These agents read untrusted content while having access to credentials and the checkout's `.git`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh: Lines 43-71 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The poller script's isolation setup block, including `ORCH_CODEX_ISOLATED_EXEC` and `ORCH_FINGERPRINT_VERIFIER`, is absent.
  WHY: The judge calls therefore run without the isolation infrastructure the PR describes.
